sections.title: The Industrialization of DePIN
sections.body: DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks) represents the most efficient way to scale a data center's business today. Instead of spending years building a global sales force, Kenya AI Compute plugs directly into established protocols like Render Network, Akash, and io.net. These networks provide a constant stream of global demand for our GPU and CPU hours. Our role is simple: provide the most reliable and cost-effective physical environment for these nodes. Because our energy costs are locked at $0.04/kWh, our nodes sit at the very top of the global profitability curve. While competitors in high-energy jurisdictions struggle with break-even points, our Kenyan facility generates consistent positive cash flow through token earnings and task fees, regardless of crypto market volatility. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models.
